_why: Golden Zod<->Pydantic parity fixture for the OCCUPATION INTELLIGENCE ENGINE contracts (the Phase 0 contract freeze). Asserted from BOTH suites — packages/ai-contracts/src/ai-contracts.test.ts and apps/ai-service/tests/test_contract_parity.py — against this one file, so adding, renaming or removing a field on either side turns the OTHER side red. Same mechanism, same reasoning, as profiling.keys.json: Pydantic IGNORES unknown request keys and Zod objects STRIP unknown response keys, so without this a field that exists on one side only passes both suites while data is silently dropped in flight.
_scope: The deterministic-profiling surface only: the answer map, the occupation pin, question packs, the ask_if/skip_if predicate AST, and POST /profile/parse. ConversationState's seven OIE fields live in profiling.keys.json because that model belongs to the chat-profiling surface. Kept separate so a change to one surface cannot quietly rewrite another's contract.
_AnswerRecord: The unit of the deterministic answer map — the parse call's PRIMARY input; the transcript is only its evidence store. `value_normalized` is written at CAPTURE time by the orchestrator, which is what makes the fail-closed projection (LLM down => profile from the map alone) real. `history` keeps corrected values: the transcript holds both, and the map is what tells the model which won.
_OccupationPin: pack_id + pack_version + catalog_version are IMMUTABLE for the conversation once pinned (risk #13). match_status carries the five job-domain statuses PLUS matched_lexical / matched_worker_confirmed, declared ahead of migration 0076 because this package freezes at Phase 0.
_Predicate: ONE object shape with an `op` discriminant rather than a tagged union, so this key list is stable; per-op arity (exactly the operator's operand keys, nothing else) is enforced by refinement on both sides and re-checked by the Phase 4 pack validator at boot. A closed JSON AST, never a string — no expression-parser injection surface.
_QuestionPack: Version-scoped and immutable by construction — immutability IS the cache invalidation. Option labels are the worker's answer of record verbatim when tapped, which is why chips are reviewed static data and never model output.
_ProfileParse: THE one LLM call. The framing is the enforcement: the model is never asked what the worker's salary is — it is asked to type and cite the answer the map already holds. `ParsedField.evidence` is MANDATORY: a value with no span fails the provenance gate, which makes a hallucinated value structurally impossible to persist.
_llmInterview: Phase A (LLM-led interview) + Phase C (whole-chat extraction). Same parity rule as everything above: Pydantic ignores unknown request keys and Zod strips unknown response keys, so a field added on one side only would pass both suites while the data was silently dropped in flight. ExperienceEntry is strict/extra-forbid on BOTH sides on purpose - it is what stops an employer_name reaching a column.
